name: North Point
text: North Point is a mixed-use urban area in the Eastern District of Hong Kong. Located in the northeastern part of Hong Kong Island, the area is named after a cape between Causeway Bay and Tsat Tsz Mui that projects towards Kowloon Bay.

depictions.name: North Point
depictions.text: North Point (Chinese: 北角) is a neighbourhood in Hong Kong. Winston Chu's Water Street Gang control part of this neighbourhood. The architecture seems to be similar to Mong Kok in Kowloon.
